look_here_first: Inspect stem hairs with a hand lens: numerous straight, forward-pointing, closely appressed NONSEPTATE hairs distinguish this from the spreading, partly septate hairs of O. stricta. Then check upright/ascending stems, usually 1–3 flowers per stalk, and mature capsules (often 12–20 mm).

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Annual or short-lived herb, stems erect to ascending; rooting pattern and stature variable.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Palmately trifoliolate, each leaflet obcordate with a shallow to pronounced apical notch; petiole bases and stipule shape worth checking.

key_traits.label: Stems
key_traits.text: Stem hairs usually dense, straight, forward-directed and closely appressed; hairs nonseptate (contrast O. stricta).

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Yellow, 5-petaled; often 1–3 flowers per inflorescence; petals commonly 4–8 mm, but overlap requires multiple characters.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Slender capsule commonly 12–20 mm, sometimes to 25 mm; inspect fully mature fruit and seed ridges.
